ARTICLE XIII - BOARD OF ZONING APPEALS Section 1300. CREATION AND MEMBERSHIP There is hereby established a Board of Zoning Appeals which shall consist of five (5) residents appointed by the Township Trustees. The Township Trustees by a majority vote, shall choose a successor to fill any vacancy. The five (5) residents first appointed shall serve for terms of one (1), two (2), three (3), four (4) and five (5) years respectively; thereafter appointments shall be for five (5) year terms, beginning January 1st. Each member shall serve until his successor is appointed and qualified. The Board shall organize annually to elect a Chairman and a Vice-Chairman. It shall further adopt rules for its own government not inconsistent with law or with any other resolutions of the Township to carry into effect the provisions of this Resolution.
